subtitulo: Smoke Tree Road · Grand Senora Desert
contenidoMarkdown:
Abandoned Vehicle 1

Smoke Tree Road · Grand Senora Desert

The Desert Stun Gun Trap

  • ›Location: Smoke Tree Road in the Grand Senora Desert (near Sandy Shores Airfield).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will spot a seemingly abandoned Surfer van parked alongside a dirt trail. As you approach to investigate, an ambusher creeps up behind you armed with a Stun Gun. If you fail to react in time, you will be incapacitated and wake up in your underwear on the train tracks with a speeding locomotive barreling down on you.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If playing as Trevor Philips, trigger his Red Mist special ability the instant you hear the taser discharge: you will shrug off the stun paralysis, take down the assailant, and claim his Stun Gun early before it unlocks for purchase at Ammu-Nation.
  • ›Reward: Stun Gun (with Trevor) and the Surfer van.

Abandoned Vehicle 2

RON Alternates Wind Farm

The Wind Farm RV Encounter

  • ›Location: Dirt tracks within the RON Alternates Wind Farm.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will discover a Journey motorhome parked between the wind turbines. Approaching the vehicle interrupts two men engaged in an intimate liaison. If you get too close or hit the bodywork, they burst out furious in their underwear wielding firearms.
  • ›Tactical Tip: This event triggers more readily at dusk or during nighttime hours. Sneaking up quietly without bumping the vehicle allows you to listen to their dialogue from outside before they emerge armed.
  • ›Reward: Journey motorhome and ammo dropped by the attackers.

Cop Arrest 1

O'Neil Farmstead · Grapeseed

Pursuit in Grapeseed

  • ›Location: Near the O'Neil Brothers farm in Grapeseed.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will witness a police cruiser chasing a fleeing suspect on foot along the rural roadside. You have complete moral freedom to side with the law or assist the fugitive.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you decide to help the officer, shoot the fugitive in the legs (or bump him gently with your car bumper) to subdue him without killing him.
  • ›If you aid the fugitive by taking out the police officer, the criminal expresses his gratitude by handing you a cash reward before fleeing into the fields.
  • ›Reward: $250 cash and a 2-star Wanted Level if helping the fugitive; no cash reward if assisting the police officer.

Cop Arrest 2

Senora Freeway · Wind Farm

The Senora Freeway Park Ranger

  • ›Location: Senora Freeway shoulder near Rex's Diner (RON Alternates Wind Farm).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A state park ranger pursues an armed runaway on foot along the highway shoulder. As with the Grapeseed encounter, you can intervene on behalf of the law or assist the criminal.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If opting for the runner's quick payout, ensure you have a fast getaway car ready before opening fire on law enforcement: a 2-star Wanted Level on an open freeway draws high-speed cruisers rapidly.
  • ›Reward: $250 cash and a 2-star Wanted Level if aiding the fugitive.

subtitulo: ATM Locations · Various San Andreas Points
contenidoMarkdown:
ATM Robbery

ATM Locations · Various San Andreas Points

Intervening at the ATM

  • ›Location: Various Fleeca Bank and Maze Bank ATMs scattered throughout Los Santos and Blaine County.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will hear shouts from a pedestrian who just had their withdrawn cash snatched by a mugger fleeing on foot or scooter. Chase down the robber before he slips off your mini-map radar.
  • ›Tactical Tip: After neutralizing the criminal and picking up the dropped cash bundle, you face a choice:
  • ›Return the wallet to the victim: The victim rewards you with 10% of the funds ($50 - $200) and your Special Ability bar refills to 100% instantly.
  • ›Pocket the cash: Keep the entire stolen sum ($500 - $2,000) for yourself.
  • ›Reward: $500 - $2,000 (if keeping the money) or instant Special Ability refill plus a modest tip (if returning it).

Bike Thief City 1

Little Bighorn Avenue · Rancho

Animal Ark Stock Windfall

  • ›Location: Little Bighorn Avenue in the Rancho neighborhood (South Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A mugger steals a bicycle from a citizen in broad daylight. Pursue the thief on foot or knock him down with a vehicle to recover the bicycle and return it to its rightful owner.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Do not ignore this event under any circumstances. While it seems like a mundane errand, the bike's owner is a corporate executive. Several in-game days later, he sends a thank-you email informing you that he gifted you $100,000 in Animal Ark shares on the LCN stock market.
  • ›Reward: +3 Stamina instantly and $100,000 in Animal Ark stock awarded via email days later.

Bike Thief City 2

Bridge Street · Hawick

Pursuit in Hawick

  • ›Location: Bridge Street in central Hawick.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A pedestrian has their bicycle snatched on the sidewalk. Chase down the thief weaving through traffic, retrieve the bike, and return it to the owner.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Keeping the bicycle provides no physical stat boosts; returning it is far more worthwhile to accelerate character progression.
  • ›Reward: +3 Stamina upon returning the bicycle.

subtitulo: Mount Haan Road · Grand Senora Desert
contenidoMarkdown:
Border Patrol 1

Mount Haan Road · Grand Senora Desert

Ambush on Mount Haan

  • ›Location: Back trails of Mount Haan Road in the Grand Senora Desert.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A squad of heavily armed rural nativist vigilantes intercepts you on motorcycles and pickup trucks, accusing you of being an illegal alien regardless of which protagonist you control.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Take cover behind boulders immediately or retaliate with drive-by fire before stepping out: attackers wield pump shotguns that are devastating at close quarters.
  • ›Reward: Up to $700 in cash dropped by the vigilantes, plus their weapons and ammunition.

Border Patrol 2

Tataviam Mountains

Ambush in the Tataviam Mountains

  • ›Location: Dirt paths along the Tataviam Mountains (east of Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A second detachment of paramilitaries cuts you off along mountain ridges and opens fire without provocation.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Keep your distance using the mountain slopes to prevent attackers from flanking you from higher ground.
  • ›Reward: Approximately $700 in cash bundles dropped on the ground, plus assault rifles.

Border Patrol 3

Raton Canyon

Ambush in Raton Canyon

  • ›Location: Rugged trails in Raton Canyon (Blaine County).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The third and final vigilante cell ambushes you along the natural canyon trails. Eliminate all squad members to secure the zone.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Use thrown explosives or sniper rifles if you spot them before they disembark from their vehicles.
  • ›Reward: Up to $700 in dropped cash and heavy ammunition.

🪦 Burial in Paleto Bay

North Point · Paleto Bay

The Rescue of Antonia Bottino

  • ›Location: Coastal wasteland at North Point, north of Paleto Bay (Blaine County).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You discover two mob hitmen armed with shovels digging a trench to bury a bound woman alive. Eliminate the two executioners quickly before they carry out the deed, then untie the victim, who reveals herself to be Antonia Bottino, daughter of infamous Liberty City capo Sammy Bottino. Drive her safely to Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›Playing as Michael or Franklin, take her to her destination without hesitation. Days later, her father wires a generous cash reward directly to your account.
  • ›Playing as Trevor Philips, you unlock the option to divert to Mount Chiliad and deliver her to the Altruist Cult for a fast $1,000, forfeiting the $60,000 mob reward.
  • ›Reward: Instant Special Ability refill and $60,000 wired to your account days later from her father (or $1,000 at the Altruist camp with Trevor).

Vinewood Tour Bus

Alta Street · Downtown Vinewood

The Route of the Los Santos Stars

  • ›Location: Alta Street outside the Oriental Theater in Downtown Vinewood (daytime only).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Vinewood Star Tours open-top bus awaits sightseers for a guided excursion exploring celebrity mansions, Richards Majestic Studios, and historic landmarks.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Board the tour by paying a small $40 fare. The tour features satirical commentary on film history and celebrity culture. You can skip ahead stop-by-stop using the skip button.
  • ›Reward: Ambient world lore and satirical dialogue (no material rewards).

️ Car Theft 1 (Pink Peyote)

Great Ocean Highway · North Chumash

Pacific Coast Carjacking

  • ›Location: Great Ocean Highway near the Hookies biker bar (North Chumash).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A female motorist screams for help after being carjacked of her vintage Vapid Peyote convertible. The thief flees at high speed along the coastal highway.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Shoot the tires or pit maneuver the Peyote to force the driver to stop. Once the thief is neutralized, you face a dilemma:
  • ›Return the car: Earn a substantial boost to your character's Driving skill.
  • ›Keep the vehicle: This model features a unique metallic bubblegum pink paint finish that cannot be replicated at Los Santos Customs. Store it in your safehouse garage.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving skill points (if returning it) or the unique pink Vapid Peyote (if keeping it).

Car Theft 2 (Obey Rocoto)

Exceptionalists Way · Los Santos International Airport (LSIA)

Carjacking at the Airport Terminal

  • ›Location: Exceptionalists Way near Los Santos International Airport.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A carjacker violently steals an Obey Rocoto luxury SUV from a business executive about to catch a flight. Chase down the perpetrator before he merges onto the freeway.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If you return the vehicle to the owner, you will receive a formal thank-you email days later informing you that she tailored an exclusive high-end designer suit, delivered directly into your safehouse wardrobe.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving skill points and an exclusive luxury suit in your wardrobe (if returning it), or the unique dark red Obey Rocoto SUV (if keeping it).

️ Getaway Gang 1 (The Lost MC in Hawick)

Hawick Avenue · Hawick

Armed Robbery at SubUrban

  • ›Location: Hawick Avenue beside the SubUrban clothing store.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed bikers from The Lost MC raid an adjacent business, leaving the manager wounded as they flee on motorcycles with a bag full of cash.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Pursue and take out both bikers on the run. Pick up the loot bag and choose your reward:
  • ›Returning the cash grants a $200 tip and instant Special Ability refill.
  • ›Keeping the cash awards $2,000 cash outright.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 cash (if kept) or $200 + instant Special Ability recharge (if returned).

️ Getaway Gang 2 (The Lost MC in Textile City)

San Andreas Avenue · Textile City

Street Snatch in the Textile District

  • ›Location: San Andreas Avenue in the heart of Textile City.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two Lost MC bikers violently snatch a pedestrian's wallet before weaving through heavy traffic.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Ram their motorcycle from behind or shoot them through your windshield. Retrieve the dropped cash and decide:
  • ›Returning the wallet rewards you with 10% ($50) and maxes out your Special Ability.
  • ›Keeping it nets the full $500 cash.
  • ›Reward: $500 cash (if kept) or $50 and full Special Ability refill (if returned).

Getaway Gang 3 (The Lost MC in Grapeseed)

Grapeseed Main Street · Grapeseed

Country Assault in a Gang Burrito

  • ›Location: Main street in Grapeseed, north of the Alamo Sea.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Lost MC gang members assault a local resident and flee in a Gang Burrito van heading toward farmland.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The van is durable but heavy. Shoot its rear tires or the driver directly to stop the chase along narrow dirt roads.
  • ›Reward: $250 clean cash (if keeping the money) or $25 and full Special Ability refill (if returned to the victim).

Getaway Gang 4 (The Lost MC on Route 68)

Route 68 · Grand Senora Desert

Checkout! Convenience Store Robbery

  • ›Location: Gas station and Checkout! convenience store on Route 68.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Lost MC van robs a customer exiting the store and speeds away down the rural highway.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Intercept the van before it reaches the Senora Freeway, where heavy truck traffic makes tactical pit maneuvers considerably harder.
  • ›Reward: $120 cash (if kept) or $12 and full Special Ability recharge (if returned).

Construction Site Accident

Calais Avenue · Little Seoul

Race-Against-Time Construction Rescue

  • ›Location: Calais Avenue inside an active construction lot in Little Seoul.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A catastrophic collapse of steel pipes crushes the cab of a Utility Truck, trapping a worker inside. The fuel tank catches fire, giving you only seconds before an explosion occurs.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Do not attempt to pull the worker out on foot or shoot at the truck. Immediately jump into the Dozer bulldozer parked meters away and use its front blade to push and clear the steel pipes blocking the driver's door. Once cleared, the worker leaps to safety.
  • ›Reward: +2 Driving skill points and a flawless rescue.

Shootout at Alamo Sea

Marina Drive · Alamo Sea

Smuggler Ambush at the Marina

  • ›Location: Marina Drive along the north shore of Alamo Sea (available only as Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A heavily armed smuggler is pinned behind a van in a fierce shootout against a squad of Lost MC bikers. Help him eliminate the initial attackers.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Once the initial bikers fall, stay alert: as the survivor runs to his vehicle, a second wave of reinforcement bikers sweeps in firing continuous bursts. Take them out before they gun down the survivor.
  • ›Reward: $1,000 cash handed to you by the grateful smuggler for saving his life.

Robbery in Harmony ($10,000)

Route 68 · Harmony

Crossfire and Abandoned Briefcases

  • ›Location: An open field along Route 68 near the town of Harmony (Grand Senora Desert).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You happen upon an intense shootout between rural sheriff deputies and armed robbers. Two briefcases stuffed with cash lie abandoned on the ground.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Keep your distance while they eliminate each other. Once the robbers are taken down (or sniped from afar), wait for clear line of sight, grab the two briefcases ($5,000 each), and escape before police reinforcements arrive.
  • ›Reward: Up to $10,000 cash between the two abandoned briefcases.

Crash Rescue (Taliana Martinez)

Great Ocean Highway · Mount Chiliad

The Best Heist Driver in San Andreas

  • ›Location: Great Ocean Highway along the coastal stretch beneath Mount Chiliad (unlocked after completing story mission The Jewel Store Job).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will spot an overturned, burning car in the ditch. Nearby lies a badly injured woman pleading for help: this is Taliana Martinez, an expert getaway driver betrayed and left for dead by her crew after a heist.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Pick her up immediately and drive at full throttle to the safehouse in Sandy Shores. A health bar depletes on screen: drive aggressively while avoiding harsh crashes that hasten her demise.
  • ›Reward: Permanent unlock of Taliana Martinez as a Heist Getaway Driver for all major story heists. She boasts top-tier driving stats (equal to Eddie Toh) while demanding only a 5% cut, saving millions across your campaign playthrough.

Deal Gone Wrong ($25,000)

Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness · Great Ocean Highway

The Bloodied Briefcase in the Wilderness

  • ›Location: Hidden clearing in the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness hills, just east of Great Ocean Highway.
  • ›Encounter Overview: An explicit homage to No Country for Old Men. You find bullet-riddled trucks, dead attack dogs, and corpses from a drug deal massacre. A dying survivor warns you not to take the money before he expires.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Head down into the ravine and pick up the silver briefcase containing $25,000 cash. If you enter a car to escape via road, two trucks loaded with armed hitmen ambush you. Tactical trick: if you climb the hill on foot toward the highway before entering any vehicle, the ambush never triggers, avoiding the firefight completely.
  • ›Reward: $25,000 full cash inside the briefcase + up to $1,000 extra dropped by pursuing hitmen.

️ Domestic Dispute (Castro Lagano)

Didion Drive · Vinewood Hills

The Ousted Golfer

  • ›Location: Didion Drive in an upscale Vinewood Hills estate.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You witness a heated marital brawl outside a mansion. A furious woman throws out her cheating husband along with his golf bag. The man, Castro Lagano, begs you for a ride to the Los Santos Golf Club.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›As Michael or Franklin, drive him to the golf club. He gives you an $80 tip and unlocks as an expert golf rival, perfect for raising Strength stats in high-level matches.
  • ›As Trevor Philips, you can drive him up to the mountains and sell him to the Altruist Cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: $80 tip and unlock of Castro Lagano as a golf rival (or $1,000 delivered to the Altruist camp with Trevor).

Weed Farm Raid ($70,000)

Mount Chiliad · Blaine County

The Clandestine Cartel Plantation

  • ›Location: Eastern slopes of Mount Chiliad (Trevor Philips only).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A hidden weed cultivation farm is guarded by an armed militia. Guards open fire immediately upon approach.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Use Trevor's Red Mist rage ability to clear the shooters behind barricades and shacks without taking critical damage. Enter the main shed and grab the briefcase. Also inspect the shed interior: one of the 50 Spaceship Parts collectibles sits inside.
  • ›Reward: Up to $70,000 cash in the briefcase and a Spaceship Part. The farm respawns periodically every few in-game weeks, serving as a recurring cash cow for Trevor.

Drunk Driver 1

Aguja Street · La Puerta

The Intoxicated Bar Patron

  • ›Location: Aguja Street outside a crowded dive bar in La Puerta.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A desperate citizen tries in vain to load his heavily intoxicated friend into an SUV. He asks you to drive the SUV and escort his drunk friend to his apartment in Alta Place, Hawick.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›Complete the delivery to Hawick to earn an $80 tip and keep the luxury Gallivanter Baller SUV.
  • ›As Trevor Philips, divert toward the mountains and sacrifice him to the Altruist Cult for a clean $1,000.
  • ›Reward: $80 tip and the Baller SUV (or $1,000 at the Altruists with Trevor).

Drunk Driver 2 (The Sandy Shores Couple)

Armadillo Avenue · Sandy Shores

Drunken Lovers in Sandy Shores

  • ›Location: Armadillo Avenue outside a motel and tavern in Sandy Shores.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A couple stumbling along the sidewalk asks you to drive them back to their motel along Route 68 before county police arrest them.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›Driving them home rewards a modest $40 tip and their Albany Emperor sedan.
  • ›As Trevor, this couple is the best delivery for the Altruist Cult, paying $1,000 each ($2,000 total) and counting as two victims toward unlocking the camp shootout.
  • ›Reward: $40 and the Emperor sedan (or $2,000 at the Altruist Cult with Trevor).

Escape Paparazzi (Lacey Jonas)

Vinewood Boulevard · Downtown Vinewood

Rescuing the Spoiled Starlet

  • ›Location: Narrow alley off Vinewood Boulevard in Downtown Vinewood.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Teen starlet Lacey Jonas is cornered in an alley by aggressive paparazzi photographers with cameras and vans. She begs you to get her out without anyone taking more photos.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Put her in a closed four-seater car and lose the paparazzi vans through alleys and sharp turns. Do not shoot or run over the paparazzi, as casualties will cause mission failure due to public scandal.
  • ›Trivia: Arriving on a Vader bike or Cavalcade causes photographers to mistake Michael for Mitch Dexter, Franklin for rapper MC Clip, and Trevor for Jock Cranley.
  • ›Altruist Option: Trevor can take Lacey to the Altruist Cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: $750 cash from Lacey upon reaching her mansion (or $1,000 at the Altruist camp with Trevor).

subtitulo: El Rancho Boulevard · El Burro Heights
contenidoMarkdown:
️ Gang Ambush (Alley Trap)

El Rancho Boulevard · El Burro Heights

The Crying Woman Decoy

  • ›Location: Corner of El Rancho Boulevard and Fudge Lane in El Burro Heights.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A crying woman on the sidewalk asks you to follow her into a dark alleyway claiming someone needs medical help.
  • ›Tactical Tip: It is a setup. The moment you round the corner, she ducks away and gang members armed with pistols and shotguns open fire from behind dumpsters and fire escapes. Enter with weapons drawn or toss a molotov immediately to neutralize the crossfire.
  • ›Reward: $200 - $500 cash dropped by fallen gang members, plus weapons and ammo.

Getaway Driver (Patrick 'Packie' McReary)

Strawberry Avenue · Forum Drive

Reunion with a Liberty City Legend

  • ›Location: Intersection of Strawberry Avenue and Forum Drive (outside Dollar Pills pharmacy).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed masked robbers hold up the pharmacy and desperately search for a four-door getaway vehicle. Approaching reveals one of the bandits is Patrick "Packie" McReary, the famed Irish mobster from the Three Leaf Clover bank heist in Grand Theft Auto IV.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Pick them up in a fast 4-door vehicle before police surround them. Lose the 2-star Wanted Level through Strawberry back alleys or rail tracks and deliver them to their safehouse. Do not kill them under any circumstance, as you would permanently forfeit one of the finest crew members in the game.
  • ›Reward: $1,000 cash and, crucially: unlocks Packie McReary as a Heist Gunman for story heists. He boasts 88% shooting skill and asks for only a 12% cut, outperforming gunmen demanding far higher shares.

Hitchhiker 1 (Tinkle Stock Tip)

Ineseno Road · Banham Canyon

The Airport Speed Run

  • ›Location: Ineseno Road in Banham Canyon along the Great Ocean Highway shoulder.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A sharply dressed financial analyst is stranded beside his broken-down car. He urgently begs for a high-speed ride to Los Santos International Airport (LSIA) departures to catch a vital business flight.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have exactly 2 minutes and 20 seconds of real time to reach the terminal. Take the Great Ocean Highway south toward the Los Santos Freeway at full speed.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving, $100 tip, and the most lucrative stock market tip among random events: he advises investing in Tinkle (TNK) on BAWSAQ. Buy shares with all three protagonists immediately after completing the ride and hold for 20 - 24 in-game hours until the stock reaches its peak return of roughly 33% before dropping.

️ Hitchhiker 2 (Ursula)

North Calafia Way · Mount Chiliad

The El Gordo Hermit

  • ›Location: North Calafia Way along the southern base of Mount Chiliad (Franklin Clinton or Trevor Philips only).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A disheveled, eccentric young woman named Ursula hitches a ride soaked in the rain. She asks to be taken to her remote house on El Gordo Drive beside the eastern lighthouse.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›Drive her to her coastal home to receive her thanks and add her to your phone contacts. Calling her for dates later triggers a unique weather mechanic: it causes torrential rain across all San Andreas, ideal for activating weather-dependent mysteries (like the Mount Chiliad UFO at 03:00 AM).
  • ›As Trevor, you can ignore her request and deliver her to the Altruist Cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving and unlocks Ursula as a special contact (or $1,000 at the Altruists with Trevor).

Hitchhiker 3 (Jealous Boyfriend)

East Joshua Road · San Chianski Mountain Range

The Vinewood Hills Brawl

  • ›Location: Intersection of East Joshua Road and the San Chianski mountain route.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A young woman flags you down requesting a ride back to her Vinewood Hills home after being stranded in the desert.
  • ›Tactical Tip: When parking outside her home, her aggressive, jealous boyfriend storms out and starts throwing punches. Exit the car and take him down in hand-to-hand combat: do not use firearms or kill him, just knock him out with your fists to avoid police attention.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving and passenger gratitude (or $1,000 delivered to the Altruists with Trevor).

Hitchhiker 4 (Runaway Bride)

Route 68 · Great Chaparral

Fleeing the Country Church Altar

  • ›Location: Side paths along Route 68 near the Great Chaparral church.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A bride in a white wedding gown runs along the road after fleeing her own ceremony. She begs you to drive her to Kimble Hill Drive in Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Tactical Tip: En route, the jilted groom chases you in a Vapid Bobcat pickup trying to ram you off the road. Either outrun him with superior top speed or pull over, step out, and knock the groom out with your fists (do not shoot him) to proceed in peace.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving skill points (or $1,000 at the Altruists with Trevor).

Ambush in La Mesa (Decoy Woman)

Supply Street · La Mesa

The Industrial Trap

  • ›Location: Supply Street among the warehouses of La Mesa (East Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A woman feigns panic and begs you to follow her down a dark alleyway to help an injured person.
  • ›Tactical Tip: As in El Burro Heights, this is an ambush: an armed accomplice steps out from behind a dumpster with a suppressed pistol. Keep your weapon ready and headshot him before he fires.
  • ›Reward: $10 - $50 cash and pistol ammunition.

Mugging 1

Strawberry Avenue · Chamberlain Hills

Chasing the Strawberry Mugger

  • ›Location: Strawberry Avenue between Strawberry and Chamberlain Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A petty crook snatches a citizen's wallet and bolts along sidewalks and pedestrian crossings.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase down the thief on foot or knock him down with your vehicle bumper. Collect the dropped wallet and choose:
  • ›Returning the wallet awards $20 and refills your Special Ability meter to 100%.
  • ›Keeping it nets $200 cash.
  • ›Reward: $200 (if keeping the money) or $20 + instant Special Ability recharge (if returning it).

Mugging 2

Meteor Street · Hawick

Life-or-Death Rescue in the Alley

  • ›Location: Meteor Street inside a residential alleyway in Hawick.
  • ›Encounter Overview: An attacker wielding a knife pins an innocent woman against a wall aiming to stab and rob her.
  • ›Tactical Tip: This encounter demands instant intervention: hesitating even two seconds allows the attacker to execute the woman, failing the event. Aim for the head and fire before he strikes.
  • ›Reward: Ammo from the attacker and the satisfaction of preventing a murder.

Mugging 3 ($2,000)

Vespucci Boulevard · Pillbox Hill

The Businessman's Briefcase

  • ›Location: Vespucci Boulevard and Alta Street near the Pillbox Hill skyscrapers.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A mugger tackles a businessman outside a bank, tears a leather briefcase from his hands, and runs into pedestrian crowds.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Hunt down the robber before he vanishes into subway stairs. Picking up the briefcase presents a choice:
  • ›Return it to the businessman for $200 and a full Special Ability refill.
  • ›Keep it for yourself to pocket a clean $2,000 cash.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 cash (if keeping it) or $200 + max Special Ability bar (if returning it).

Prisoner Lift 1

North Bolingbroke · Grand Senora Desert

The Escaped Convict

  • ›Location: Back roads north of Bolingbroke Penitentiary (Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton only).
  • ›Encounter Overview: An escaped inmate wearing bright orange prison coveralls runs along the roadside having slipped past prison spotlights. He begs for a ride to the Lost MC clubhouse in Sandy Shores.
  • ›Tactical Tip: During the drive, a Sheriff patrol spots you, triggering a 1-star Wanted Level. Break line of sight through desert dirt paths before dropping off the convict at his destination.
  • ›Reward: +3 Driving skill points.

️ Prisoner Lift 2 (Inmate Ambush)

South Bolingbroke · Grand Senora Desert

The Overturned Cruiser Ambush

  • ›Location: South perimeter of Bolingbroke Penitentiary, beside an overturned, burning Sheriff cruiser.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Another convict in orange coveralls waves for help simulating injury after the transport crash.
  • ›Tactical Tip: High Alert! The moment you pull over, the convict draws a stolen police pistol, pulls you out of your car, and tries to steal your vehicle. Do not stop beside him: exit with weapons drawn or shoot him through the glass before he surprises you.
  • ›Reward: Pistol ammo and retaining your vehicle intact.

️ Rogue Altruists

Baytree Canyon Road · Grand Senora Desert

Canyon Kidnapping

  • ›Location: Dirt tracks of Baytree Canyon Road connecting Los Santos to the Grand Senora Desert (Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton only).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two elderly Altruist cultists corner a helpless female hiker, threatening her with handguns aiming to kidnap her to their mountain camp.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Shoot both cultists immediately before they execute the hiker. Untie her, bring her into your car, and drive her safely to Sandy Shores.
  • ›The Altruist Camp Climax: Delivering 4 victims in total to the Mount Chiliad camp as Trevor Philips triggers the Altruist Cult Shootout. Upon clearing out all cultists, you can loot 4 briefcases with $25,000 each ($100,000 total), an RPG launcher, and body armor from their porches.
  • ›Reward: $80 tip and hiker gratitude.

Armored Truck 1 (La Puerta)

Innocence Boulevard · La Puerta

Gruppe Sechs Gas Station Robbery

  • ›Location: Gas station between Innocence Boulevard and Alta Street (La Puerta).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Gruppe Sechs armored truck is parked by the fuel pumps. An armed guard exits the store carrying a cash bag.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have two tactical options:
  • ›Precision Hit: Drop the guard carrying the case before he loads it into the truck, snagging the cash instantly without breaching the doors.
  • ›Explosive Breach: If the case is inside, plant a Sticky Bomb on the rear door seam or blast the lock with a shotgun until the doors burst open. Flee immediately to shake the 2-star Wanted Level.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 2 (Little Seoul / Lucky Plucker)

Vespucci Boulevard · Little Seoul

Lucky Plucker Armored Heist

  • ›Location: Parking lot of the Lucky Plucker restaurant on Vespucci Boulevard.
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored van is parked while guards execute a routine cash pickup.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The rear alley offers an ideal angle to snipe the courier using a suppressed rifle. If the guards panic and drive off, shoot the tires immediately.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 3 (Paleto Bay)

Paleto Boulevard · Paleto Bay

Northern Cash Consignment Raid

  • ›Location: Western end of Paleto Boulevard outside the commercial district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Gruppe Sechs truck stopped on the main street collecting morning cash receipts.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Due to distance from Los Santos police HQ, local sheriff response is slightly delayed. Blow the rear doors with explosives and flee along the Great Ocean Highway or up Mount Chiliad trails.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 clean cash.

Armored Truck 4 (Adam's Apple)

Adam's Apple Boulevard · Little Seoul

Commercial Lot Ambush

  • ›Location: Small commercial lot on Adam's Apple Boulevard (Little Seoul).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored truck stops to collect revenue from adjacent shops.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Block the parking exit with a heavy vehicle before attacking. Neutralize both guards, blow the rear door, and use narrow side streets to ditch the police chopper.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 5 (Vespucci Canals)

Prosperity Street · Vespucci Canals

Moving Van Ambush in the Canals

  • ›Location: Prosperity Street through the Vespucci Canals (traveling northbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Unlike parked vans, this Gruppe Sechs truck is on an active transit route escorted by two armed guards.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Overtake and block the van on one of the narrow canal bridges. Stick an explosive to the rear door and detonate it in motion so the case drops onto the road. Jump onto canal boats or duck under bridges to escape.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 6 (Little Seoul / Hit 'n' Run)

San Andreas Avenue · Little Seoul

San Andreas Avenue Downtown Ambush

  • ›Location: San Andreas Avenue outside Hit 'n' Run Coffee (Little Seoul, eastbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The truck drives along one of the busiest downtown corridors.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Shoot the tires with an AP Pistol or SMG through your window to cause the truck to crash into lampposts. Take out the guards before they step out with shotguns and blow the back doors.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 7 (San Chianski)

Chianski Passage · San Chianski Mountain Range

Isolated Highland Convoy Raid

  • ›Location: Chianski Passage mountain pass (traveling northbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Armored truck transiting the lonely eastern coastal mountain route.
  • ›Tactical Tip: One of the easiest truck raids: with no civilian traffic nearby, police response takes longer. Ram it, blow the back doors, and hide in coastal sea cliffs.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 8 (Tongva Hills)

Great Ocean Highway · Tongva Hills

Coastal Highway Pursuit

  • ›Location: Great Ocean Highway near the Route 68 junction (southbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The truck cruises at speed along the coastal route near Marlowe Vineyards.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Toss a Sticky Bomb directly onto the rear door while pulling alongside. Detonate in motion: the briefcase drops onto the road, letting you brake, scoop it up, and head up Marlowe Vineyards dirt tracks.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Armored Truck 9 (Cypress Flats)

El Rancho Boulevard · Cypress Flats

Industrial District Ambush

  • ›Location: El Rancho Boulevard near Orchardville Avenue (Cypress Flats, westbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The truck drives through the heavy industrial warehouse zone of southeast Los Santos.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Cut across to stop it between warehouses. Blow the doors and flee into the concrete Los Santos River flood canal or nearby subterranean train tracks to ditch the 2-star Wanted Level instantly.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 clean cash.

Armored Truck 10 (La Mesa)

Supply Street · La Mesa

La Mesa Rail Corridor Ambush

  • ›Location: Supply Street near Popular Street (La Mesa, southbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The last of the ten Gruppe Sechs armored trucks moves along rail sidings and scrap yards.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Toss a Sticky Bomb or cut it off at the rail crossing. Blow the back doors, grab the case, and escape down into the subterranean subway rails or river canal.
  • ›Reward: $3,000 - $8,000 cash.

Bob Mulet Hair Salon Robbery ($2,000)

Eastbourne Way · Rockford Hills

Luxury Barber Shop Hold-Up

  • ›Location: Bob Mulet hair salon on Eastbourne Way in upscale Rockford Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed robbers hold up staff at gunpoint for the register cash. The bandits sprint out and jump into a parked sedan to flee through the hills.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase the getaway car and shoot through the windows to take out the driver and passenger. Pick up the dropped money bag and choose whether to return it or keep it.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 cash if keeping the stolen money.

️ SubUrban Store Robbery (25% Discount)

Prosperity Street Promenade · Del Perro

Armed Robbery on the Promenade

  • ›Location: SubUrban clothing store along the Prosperity Street Promenade in Del Perro.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed robbers loot the register and flee through the pedestrian mall firing warning shots.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Neutralize the fugitives before they reach a getaway car and collect the stolen cash bag.
  • ›Keeping the bag awards $2,000 cash.
  • ›Returning the cash to the store clerk unlocks a permanent perk: a 25% discount on your next clothing purchase at any SubUrban store.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 (if keeping the money) or a 25% discount at SubUrban (if returning it).

Revenge on Simeon Yetarian

Power Street · Strawberry

Settlement at the Dealership

  • ›Location: Premium Deluxe Motorsport dealership at Adam's Apple Boulevard and Power Street.
  • ›Spawn Window: Available only as Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton between story missions Friend Request and The Jewel Store Job.
  • ›Encounter Overview: After severing business ties with Simeon over his predatory repo scams, walking into the showroom prompts Simeon to yell "Traitor!" and order armed bodyguards to execute you.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Take cover behind showroom pillars or display cars and take down the two bodyguards. Simeon flees panicked toward the back office: you can spare him or eliminate the loan shark once and for all.
  • ›Reward: Narrative satisfaction, lore context, and weapons/ammo dropped by the guards.

Lost Hostage (Snatched)

South Mo Milton Drive · Vinewood Hills

Vinewood Hills Kidnapping

  • ›Location: South Mo Milton Drive on a quiet bend in Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Armed Lost MC bikers force a young woman into the back of a black Gang Burrito van.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Intervene immediately by gunning down the bikers before the van speeds off. Bring the victim into your car and prepare for pursuit: several Lost motorcycles will follow firing sawn-off shotguns as you escort her home.
  • ›Altruist Option: As Trevor Philips, you can betray her and deliver her to the Altruist Cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: Victim gratitude (or $1,000 at the Altruists with Trevor).

️ Sport Bike Theft (Bati 801)

North Rockford Drive · Richman

Pursuit Through Richman Streets

  • ›Location: North Rockford Drive in affluent Richman.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A citizen yells for help after being mugged of his Pegassi Bati 801 sport bike by a thief speeding off.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Hop into a fast car or chase on foot immediately. Shoot the tires or pit the bike to knock the rider off without exploding it, then neutralize the thief.
  • ›Reward: Return the bike to the owner for +5 Driving skill points, or keep the customized Pegassi Bati 801 for your garage.

Bachelor Party (Stag Do)

Route 68 · Great Chaparral

The Prank Gone Too Far

  • ›Location: Route 68 roadside in semi-arid Great Chaparral.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You find a groom stripped to his underwear and taped to a utility pole. Cutting him loose reveals his friends took bachelor party pranks too far, and he must reach Paleto Bay church before his bride calls off the wedding.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have a strict 5 in-game hour time limit. Drive him to his Rockford Hills mansion to change into his wedding tuxedo and collect car keys; then swing by Hookies restaurant in North Chumash to pick up a tardy best man; finally speed up the coast to Paleto Bay church before time runs out.
  • ›Altruist Option: As Trevor Philips, you can ignore his wedding and sell him to the Altruist Cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: Completing the rescue rewards you with the keys to his luxury white Enus Super Diamond sedan.

Duel: Imponte Duke O'Death

Route 68 · Grand Senora Desert

Desert Gas Station Ambush

  • ›Location: Abandoned gas station café along Route 68, west of Los Santos Customs in Grand Senora Desert.
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Enhanced Edition (PS4, Xbox One, PC, PS5, Xbox Series) after completing story mission Mr. Philips.
  • ›Encounter Overview: In the café lot sits the menacing armored muscle car: the Imponte Duke O'Death. Entering it triggers an ambush by local rednecks.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The instant you enter the car, JoBuilt Phantom semi-trucks and Karin Rebel/Dubsta 4x4s ram and open fire on you. Use the Duke O'Death's front armor and reinforced louvers to ram through their barricade, or step out behind cover with heavy weapons to wipe them out.
  • ›Reward: Permanent unlock of the Imponte Duke O'Death. It respawns reliably at El Burro Heights scrapyard and the Grand Senora Desert, and unlocks for purchase on Warstock Cache & Carry.

️ Dodo Seaplane (Sea Cave)

Sea Cave · East Coast (San Chianski)

Smuggler Grotto Raid

  • ›Location: Large sea cave hidden in the cove east of RON Alternates Wind Farm and San Chianski.
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Enhanced Edition after completing story mission Nervous Ron.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Access the cave by sea (boat, jet ski, or swimming). Inside, armed smugglers guard a coveted Mammoth Dodo seaplane moored in the basin.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Eliminate the guards on catwalks and Squalo patrol boats. Once in the cockpit, two armed pursuit boats appear at the cave mouth. Throttle up hard down the cavern water channel and take off into the open ocean dodging crossfire.
  • ›Reward: Unlocks the Mammoth Dodo seaplane at Galilee dock (Alamo Sea) and the Vinewood Hills reservoir lake, plus purchase on Elitás Travel ($500,000).

Monkey Mosaics (Space Monkey)

Los Santos Customs · Burton

The Space Monkey Street Artist

  • ›Location: Back alley adjacent to Los Santos Customs in Burton (Los Santos).
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Enhanced Edition after photographing all 50 Monkey Mosaics across San Andreas walls with your phone camera.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Upon photographing the 50th mosaic, you receive an email alerting you that the elusive artist was spotted tagging an alley in Burton.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Approach the location with absolute stealth. Crouch down at the alley mouth and zoom in with your phone camera from mid-range to frame the artist as he sprays the wall. Caution: running loudly causes him to flee before you can snap the shot.
  • ›Reward: Unlocks the exclusive Dinka Go Go Monkey Blista sports car in safehouse garages for all three protagonists, along with Space Monkey clothing sets in their wardrobes.
